architectural_determination: Entry-path equivalence is a mandatory precondition, not an after-the-fact adapter. H6 and H7 both fail the invariant under the consumed v2 freeze. The current freeze cannot be retried or reused. A new evaluation contract may proceed only by selecting forms already accepted by existing productive entry paths and independently freezing a new corpus before exposure. No ROBY production change or benchmark-specific routing is authorized.

H6.reason: Held-out natural-language prompts do not satisfy the certified Decisión/Criterios/Evidencia productive intake grammar.

H7.reason: Calibration proved internal planning re-entry, not an equivalent conversation-entry path to the same productive authority.

next_gate: HCPDQ-v2 Entry-Path Equivalent Evaluation — Recontract / New Independent Freeze Scope
recontract_scope: evaluation entry/exposure contract and a new independent freeze only

rules.requirement: Calibration and held-out must enter through the same productive intake.
Held-out prompts must satisfy the same intake grammar as calibration.
No benchmark-specific translation, router or semantic adapter is allowed.
Internal re-entry certification cannot substitute for user-entry proof.
The same existing productive authority must be causally observed.
Entry-path equivalence must be certified before held-out exposure.
A consumed invalid primary run cannot be retried under the same freeze.
